query: UPDATE agent_sessions s SET last_seen_at=GREATEST(s.last_seen_at,clock_timestamp()),title=COALESCE(s.title,CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM executions earlier JOIN executions current ON current.id=$1 WHERE earlier.session_id=s.id AND (earlier.started_at,earlier.id)<(current.started_at,current.id)) THEN $2 ELSE NULL END) WHERE s.id=(SELECT session_id FROM executions WHERE id=$1)
